title: New in Symfony 8.2: AssetMapper Improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>AssetMapper lets you use modern JavaScript and CSS without a build step,
relying on native browser features like import maps. Symfony 8.2 improves it in
several areas: security of third-party packages, control over what the import
map exposes, and a smoother…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
